questions.question: What is the difference between a side view and a plan view, and why are maps drawn as plan views?
questions.expected_answer: A side view is seen from the side and shows how tall things are. A plan view is seen from straight above. Maps are drawn as plan views because, from above, nothing is hidden and you can see where every place is compared with others.

questions.question: Name the two oceans along South Africa's coast, and name four provinces with their capital cities.
questions.expected_answer: The Atlantic Ocean is on the west coast and the Indian Ocean is on the south and east coasts. Any four provinces with capitals, such as Western Cape, Cape Town; Gauteng, Johannesburg; Limpopo, Polokwane; KwaZulu-Natal, Pietermaritzburg.

questions.question: Name four qualities of a good leader and explain how Nelson Mandela showed one of them.
questions.expected_answer: A good leader listens, serves the people, works for the good of others, works with a team, has courage, and is dedicated, committed and willing to sacrifice. For example, Mandela showed sacrifice by spending twenty-seven years in prison for the freedom of all South Africans.
